---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for the Thiosphere project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

Describe specific use cases where this feature would be valuable:

1. **Use Case 1**: [Description]
2. **Use Case 2**: [Description]
3. **Use Case 3**: [Description]

## Impact Assessment

- **User Impact**: [How many users would benefit?]
- **Complexity**: [Low/Medium/High - estimated implementation difficulty]
- **Priority**: [Low/Medium/High - relative importance]
- **Dependencies**: [Any other features or changes required]

## Technical Considerations

- **Design Changes**: [Will this require design modifications?]
- **Material Changes**: [Will this require new materials?]
- **Tool Changes**: [Will this require different tools?]
- **Documentation**: [What documentation updates would be needed?]

## Mockups or Examples

If applicable, add mockups, sketches, or examples here.

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have provided a clear problem statement
- [ ] I have described specific use cases
- [ ] I have considered technical implications
- [ ] I understand this is an open source project and will be patient with responses
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature if possible
